name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
overview: A component of the National Social Assistance Programme providing monthly pension to elderly persons belonging to below poverty line households.
objectives: Provide social assistance to elderly persons living below poverty line
Ensure basic income security in old age

benefits.title: Monthly Pension
benefits.description: Central assistance of Rs. 200 to Rs. 500 per month depending on age, supplemented by state contribution

otherCriteria: Belonging to a household below the poverty line as per state BPL list

applicationProcess.description: Apply through Gram Panchayat/Urban Local Body or Social Welfare Department
Verification of age and BPL status
Pension credited monthly to bank/post office account

faqs.question: What is the minimum age for IGNOAPS?
Is BPL status mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants must belong to a BPL household as per state records.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
ministry.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

overview: A scheme to provide senior citizens belonging to the BPL category with free physical aids and assisted-living devices to overcome age-related disabilities and infirmities.
objectives: Provide assistive devices to senior citizens with age-related disabilities
Improve mobility and quality of life for elderly BPL persons
Enable independent living for the elderly

benefits.title: Free Aids and Appliances
benefits.description: Devices such as walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids and spectacles provided free of cost

otherCriteria: BPL or annual income up to prescribed threshold; suffering from age-related disabilities

applicationProcess.description: District-level camps organised to assess beneficiaries
Medical assessment to identify required aids
Distribution of assistive devices at camp

faqs.question: Is there a cost to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: No, devices are distributed free of cost.

faqs.question: How are beneficiaries identified?
faqs.answer: Through district-level assessment camps organised by ALIMCO/state agencies.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Finance
ministry.department: Department of Financial Services / Life Insurance Corporation of India

overview: A pension scheme for senior citizens administered by LIC, offering an assured rate of return on a lump-sum investment for a guaranteed pension over the policy term.
objectives: Provide social security to senior citizens through assured pension
Protect elderly investors from market-linked risk

benefits.title: Assured Pension
benefits.description: Guaranteed periodic pension based on the purchase price and government-notified interest rate

otherCriteria: Indian citizens aged 60 years and above investing a lump sum with LIC

customQuestions.question: Are you a senior citizen aged 60 years or above?
Are you an Indian citizen?
Are you willing to purchase a 10-year pension policy under PMVVY?
Can you make the required purchase-price investment for the pension option selected?

Do you want to receive the pension monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually?  Select option  One option required  6  Do you have the required KYC/identity documents for purchasing the policy through LIC?

applicationProcess.description: Approach LIC branch or online LIC portal
Choose pension payment frequency and pay purchase price
Get periodic pension as per chosen frequency

faqs.question: Who administers PMVVY?
faqs.answer: Life Insurance Corporation of India, under Ministry of Finance oversight.

faqs.question: What is the minimum entry age?
faqs.answer: 60 years, with no upper age limit.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Finance
ministry.department: Department of Economic Affairs / National Savings Institute

overview: A government-backed savings instrument for senior citizens offering regular quarterly interest income and capital safety, available through banks and post offices.
objectives: Provide a safe, regular income avenue for senior citizens
Offer higher interest rates than regular savings instruments
Ensure capital protection for elderly investors

benefits.title: Quarterly Interest Payout
benefits.description: Government-notified interest rate paid quarterly on deposits

benefits.title: Tax Benefit
benefits.description: Deposits eligible for deduction under Section 80C

otherCriteria: Individuals aged 60+, or 55+ for retired defence personnel and civilian retirees under specific conditions

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

overview: A programme to provide accessible, affordable and quality healthcare services to the elderly, including dedicated geriatric clinics and rehabilitation services at various levels of healthcare facilities.
objectives: Provide preventive and curative healthcare services for the elderly
Train healthcare workers in geriatric care

benefits.title: Geriatric Health Services
benefits.description: Dedicated geriatric clinics, ward facilities and home-based care for elderly patients

otherCriteria: Elderly persons accessing public healthcare facilities

customQuestions.question: Are you an elderly person aged 60 years or above?
Are you seeking geriatric healthcare services through a government health facility?
Do you require any preventive, promotive, curative or rehabilitative healthcare service related to ageing?
Do you require services such as geriatric consultation, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation or follow-up care?

applicationProcess.description: Visit district hospital or Community Health Centre with geriatric clinic

faqs.question: What services are available?
faqs.answer: Outpatient geriatric care, physiotherapy, and referral services.

faqs.question: Is there a fee?
faqs.answer: Services at public health facilities are provided at nominal or no cost as per state policy.
